description: JupiterOne is a cyber asset management software designed to assist organizations in gaining visibility and control over their digital environment. This software enables users to centralize and analyze data regarding their assets, including cloud infrastructure,devices, identities, applications, and network resources. JupiterOne provides automated relationship mapping among assets, facilitating security operations, compliance initiatives, and risk assessments. It supports asset inventory, policy monitoring, and incident response capabilities. The software aims to address challenges in security data aggregation, enabling teams to quickly identify gaps, monitor changes, and enforce security policies across complex technology landscapes.
